verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents a personal API key for CLI authentication that it calls suitable for automated workflows and external applications (docs-9). It also offers an organization Public API key for management tasks (docs-8). Neither is shown to be scoped or least-privilege, and the documented `bw serve` mode exposes the whole vault to an agent (probe-rt-1), which works against the least-privilege part of the story. Missing for 10: per-agent credentials limited to specific items or collections, read-only or permission-scoped tokens, revocation and expiry controls, and independent corroboration of scoped agent access.
